name: @openav/dmx
description: DMX lighting from a web page: fixture profiles, a patch, a deterministic engine (scenes, cues, chases, effects, safety caps), Art-Net, sACN and Enttec DMX USB Pro bytes, transports (memory, the out-bridge, Web Serial), params and an on-page monitor. No dependencies.

lab.autowire: lab.dmx = { patch (meta.dmx.patch), engine, out, frame(t), monitor(el), params(opts) }: a DMX rig rendered by DmxEngine; out is sim by default, ?dmx=bridge sends through lab.out (the out-bridge: Art-Net, sACN, Enttec), ?dmx=serial an Enttec DMX USB Pro by Web Serial (connect() from a click). The engine reads no signal: drive it through params.
